verdict.rationale: Firebase documents programmatic interfaces for its data and auth planes. These include Firestore query APIs, a MongoDB-compatible Firestore API (Enterprise edition), Auth SDK sign-in methods, and HTTPS/Admin SDK-triggered Cloud Functions; a community user also notes an HTTP API was added. Project management can be automated via the official CLI and MCP server, but probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec or llms.txt, and no REST API reference is cited. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), cited REST/management API reference docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven automation.
